title: Belijdenissen
author: Aurelius Augustinus
description:
Confessiones, by Aurelius Augustinus, is presented in this volume with extensive commentary by Fr. Arcangelo della Presentazione. This Latin edition offers a detailed exploration of Augustine's seminal work, addressing criticisms and interpretations from various sources. This historical text provides insights into the theological and philosophical foundations of early Christianity through Augustine's personal reflections and spiritual journey. Readers will find value in the thorough analysis and historical context provided, making it an essential resource for scholars and enthusiasts of Christian history and theology.
